class.name: BSPShape3D
class.brief_description: Stores Source BSP triangle collision data as a 3D physics shape.
class.description: [BSPShape3D] is a SourcePP collision shape resource for BSP map geometry. It stores triangle faces, derived bounds, and backface collision state, and currently feeds those faces to Godot's concave polygon physics shape. The data layout is intentionally explicit so future BSP-tree collision data can be added without changing import callers.

method.name: get_bounds
method.description: Returns the bounds derived from the current triangle faces.

method.name: get_data
method.description: Returns the shape data dictionary, including [code]faces[/code], [code]bounds[/code], [code]backface_collision[/code], and [code]face_count[/code].

method.name: get_face_count
method.description: Returns the number of triangle faces stored in the shape.

method.name: get_faces
method.description: Returns triangle vertices grouped as consecutive triplets.

method.name: set_data
method.description: Sets the shape from a dictionary containing [code]faces[/code] and optionally [code]backface_collision[/code].

method.name: set_faces
method.description: Sets triangle vertices grouped as consecutive triplets and recalculates bounds.

members.member: If [code]true[/code], the underlying concave collision shape collides against triangle backfaces.
